response: proton-induced SBU cross section per stored bit versus incident proton energy

source_paper.citation: C. Poivey et al., In-flight observations of long-term SEE performance on XTE SSRs, IEEE Radiation Effects Data Workshop, 2004

assigned_digitization_uncertainty.meaning: image-reading uncertainty only; it is not an experimental confidence interval

fit_policy.reason: Only four energy locations and no sub-threshold point are visible. A free four-parameter fit is not identifiable; fixing S=1 prevents a numerically precise but physically unconstrained fit.
fit_policy.nominal: least-squares in log10(sigma) to the geometric mean of the two independent Figure-8 datasets at each energy
fit_policy.envelope: pointwise min/max of separate fixed-S fits to references 9 and 11, expanded by +/-0.12 dex digitization uncertainty

independence_statement: No XTE flight upset count was used to digitize or fit this response. Flight counts remain reserved for later validation.
